description: This file defines the CreateThingResponse class, which is a response object for a CreateThing command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON, accessing the created Thing, and serialization details.

classes.name: CreateThingResponse
classes.description: A response object representing the result of a CreateThing command, including methods to parse from JSON, access the created Thing, and manage response headers.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new CreateThingResponse instance from a Thing and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a CreateThingResponse from a JSON string or object.

methods.name: getThingCreated
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the created Thing.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the created Thing.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the created Thing according to a schema version.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer representing the resource path.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the payload to a JSON object builder based on schema version and predicate.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response instance with updated headers.
